body:
Built a companion gallery page to the existing Reading Room, adapting its exact design tokens/typography (same warm off-white/gold documentary palette, Georgia/Cormorant Garamond serif, Inter sans labels, light+dark auto). Drafted via the Design canvas skill first (published as a Claude Design artifact for review), then deployed the real, fully-working version directly to /var/www/okemily/tyler/screening-room/ (the design canvas itself can't embed real video -- no network egress, 16MB payload cap -- so the canvas used placeholder play-button frames; the live page uses real <video controls> elements). All 5 real Season 1 cold-open videos (from the MPT season run) copied into videos/ and verified live (200s, exact byte counts). Added a reciprocal cross-link between the Reading Room and the Screening Room. No repo commit needed -- /var/www/okemily/tyler/ is a direct-deploy-only tree with no git repo backing it (checked), matching the existing convention for every other /tyler/ episode page.

⚓ ☃
title: TYLER Screening Room: real video gallery live at okemily.com/tyler/screening-room/
